thread:
Kai: quick flag from nightly: ran Monarch customer LoRA (monarch-lora-1) as int4 and hit a weird duplicate-sign and truncation issue in invoice prompts. Full quick-probe attached.

Devin: ugh, duplicate sign? paste command + a short failing sample.

Kai: command I used:
```
./bench/run_quick_eval --model monarch-lora-1 --quant=int4 --prompts=customers/monarch/invoice_smoke.json --out=/tmp/monarch_int4.json --batch=6 --seed=2026
```
Summary: 44/60 pass, sign-integrity 0.79 (float16 baseline 0.98), one truncation case on 2048-context invoice.

Kai: failing sample (redacted): expected "-\$1,200.00" -> got "- -$1,200.00" (duplicate negative) and another prompt where the line breaks and rest of invoice is missing after ~130 tokens.

Nora: duplicate negative sign usually means tokenization boundary or output-proj producing an extra "-" token. Did you use the same tokenizer and merges as float baseline?

Kai: yes, forced customers/monarch/tokenizer.json. Also tried toggling bias-correction and stable-detok flags; no change.

Arjun: paste KV and logits around the duplicate sign and the truncation token range. Also try with `--log-lprobs` if possible.

Kai: KV + logit excerpt (trimmed):
```
# around token 94-100 (duplicate sign)
kv[93] = <tok 45: "-">  logit_top = -1.2
kv[94] = <tok 5021: "$"> logit_top = -0.8
kv[95] = <tok 5: "-">  logit_top = -0.9  # unexpected extra '-' with similar score
kv[96] = <tok 29: "1">  logit_top = 0.3
# at truncation (~token 132)
kv[130] = <tok 12: ".">
kv[131] = <tok 7: "00">
kv[132] = <tok 0: "\n">
kv[133] = <tok 45: "-"> # dp drop ~0.14 vs float16 baseline
kv[134] = <tok 5021: "$"> # subsequent tokens missing in output
```

Kai: note the logit scores for the extra '-' are only slightly lower than the true next token, and dp (dot-product) at kv[133] is down ~0.14 compared to float baseline.

Arjun: looks like quantization changed relative logits around punctuation which lets an extra '-' slip through. For truncation dp drop at kv[133] suggests output-projection scaling mismatch too. Two mitigations: (A) per-channel rescale on int4 quant, (B) small-headed bias-alignment calibration using a handful of customer prompts. Try A first.

Kai: ran per-channel rescale -> sign-integrity moves to 0.96, pass 57/60, duplicate '-' disappears on repro. Truncation also resolved on the long invoice.

Nora: perf impact? we need numbers for Dedicated SLO and change request.

Kai: measured perf on 2048-context bench: latency +4.2%, p95 within customer SLO. Memory unchanged.

Devin: good. Action items: 1) Arjun add a model-profile recommending "int4 + per-channel-rescale" for monarch-lora-1 and include a short note about the duplicate-sign regression we saw; 2) Kai run the full quickpack with rescale and upload artifacts / sample diffs to the PR; 3) Ops: when promoting to Dedicated include perf delta (+4.2% p95) and a brief canary plan.

CanaryBot: FYI we require a 100-request canary at 10% traffic for 24h for any profile change to Dedicated.

Arjun: will open the profile PR and include suggested tiny bias-align calibration as fallback if customers want lower latency.

Kai: kicked full quickpack qp-2026-03-21-monarch-int4-rescale at 1755556798. Will attach full logs and sample diffs when done. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: QuickProbe job qp-2026-03-21-monarch-int4-rescale started by Kai at 1755556790.

Devin: nice triage. If full pack holds we'll mark the model as "int4-compatible (rescale recommended)" and notify Monarch.

Kai: thanks all \\:rocket:
